    Roiter's rank consequence for split-basic projective categories #

    BGRS 1.5 deduces the one-dimensional middle-sandwich conclusion from the literal square-annihilation alternative. A morphism which prohibits cotransit transfers source-radical coefficients into the square of the target radical; dually, a morphism which prohibits transit transfers target-radical coefficients into the square of the source radical. Thus either square alternative puts the entire middle-sandwich range in an endpoint bimodule socle, whose dimension is at most one by distributivity.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.SplitBasicIdempotents.ProjectiveCategory.exists_target_jacobson_sq_transfer_of_not_allowsCotransit {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {A : Type v} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [Module.Finite k A] {ι : Type x} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (S : SplitBasicIdempotents) [HasBGRSDistributiveHomStructure k S.ProjectiveCategory] {i j : S.ProjectiveCategory} (f : i ⟶ j) (hnot : ¬AllowsCotransit f) (a : ↥(Ring.jacobson (CategoryTheory.End i))) :
    ∃ b ∈ Ring.jacobson (CategoryTheory.End j) ^ 2, CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (↑a).asHom f = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f b.asHom

    A morphism which prohibits cotransit sends every source-radical coefficient across to the square of the target radical. This is the source-to-target half of the strict inclusion displayed in BGRS 1.5.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.SplitBasicIdempotents.ProjectiveCategory.exists_source_jacobson_sq_transfer_of_not_allowsTransit {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {A : Type v} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [Module.Finite k A] {ι : Type x} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (S : SplitBasicIdempotents) [HasBGRSDistributiveHomStructure k S.ProjectiveCategory] {i j : S.ProjectiveCategory} (f : i ⟶ j) (hnot : ¬AllowsTransit f) (b : ↥(Ring.jacobson (CategoryTheory.End j))) :
    ∃ a ∈ Ring.jacobson (CategoryTheory.End i) ^ 2, CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f (↑b).asHom = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a.asHom f

    A morphism which prohibits transit sends every target-radical coefficient across to the square of the source radical. This is the dual strict inclusion displayed in BGRS 1.5.

    ∃ (P : ClosedZigzagTransfer.OrientedRadicalPowerParameter Y), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f (P.tau ^ 2).asHom ≠ 0 ∧ CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (P.tau ^ 2).asHom g ≠ 0

    The exact radical-parameter reduction at the start of BGRS Section 4.1. If neither half of Roiter's square alternative holds, one may choose a single generator tau of the middle endomorphism radical for which both displayed square composites are nonzero.

    Under either half of Roiter's square alternative, every middle endomorphism sandwich lies in the endpoint bimodule socle.

    For split-basic primitive projectives, the literal square alternative is enough to install exactly the rank-only Roiter interface used by BGRS 4.2.
